title: Locked Out

pre.en: What was the narrator's real problem?
pre.zh: 叙述者真正的问题出在哪儿？
options: He thought the door was locked, but it wasn't.
He lost his keys on the stairs.
His flatmate took his keys to work.
The wind broke his kitchen window.

intro: 又是一篇新概念式的小故事：一个下雨的周六，「我」提着购物袋上楼，接着一件倒霉事连着一件。读的时候留意两种过去时态的分工：正在进行、做背景的动作用过去进行时（was carrying），中途突然发生的事用一般过去时（rang）。还要留意作者一笔带过的小细节，结尾会用上它。

sentences.en: I always drop my keys on the kitchen table when I get home.
sentences.zh: 我一到家，总是顺手把钥匙往厨房桌上一扔。

sentences.en: Last Saturday, that little habit cost me my whole afternoon.
sentences.zh: 上周六，就这么个小习惯，害我搭进去一整个下午。

sentences.en: It was raining, and the lift wasn't working — again.
sentences.zh: 那天下着雨，电梯偏偏又坏了。

sentences.en: I carried two bags of shopping up, left the door open and went back down for the rest.
sentences.zh: 我先拎了两袋东西上楼，门没关，又下去拿剩下的。

sentences.en: I was carrying them up the stairs when my phone rang.
sentences.zh: 我正拎着往楼上爬，手机响了。

sentences.en: While I was looking for it in my pocket, the wind slammed my door shut.
sentences.zh: 我正在兜里摸手机，一阵风「砰」地把门关上了。

sentences.en: And when I finally picked up?
sentences.zh: 等我终于接起来，你猜是谁？

sentences.en: It was a man selling windows.
sentences.zh: 是个推销窗户的。

sentences.en: My keys, of course, were on the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 钥匙嘛，当然在厨房桌上。

sentences.en: I didn't even try the handle.
sentences.zh: 我连门把手都没试一下。

sentences.en: Tom, my flatmate, was working a double shift, so I took a deep breath and called a locksmith.
sentences.zh: 室友 Tom 那天连上两个班，我只好深吸一口气，打电话叫开锁师傅。

sentences.en: He was busy, but he promised to call me back.
sentences.zh: 师傅说他正忙，答应一会儿给我回电话。

sentences.en: Then Mrs Wang's son came home from football.
sentences.zh: 这时，王太太的儿子踢完球回来了。

sentences.en: "Did you lock yourself out?" he asked.
sentences.zh: 「你把自己锁外面了？」他问。

sentences.en: It took him ten minutes to find a ladder, and then it only reached his mum's window.
sentences.zh: 他花了十分钟找来一架梯子，结果梯子只够得着他妈妈家的窗户。

sentences.en: I nearly gave up and went to a hotel, but my wallet was inside too.
sentences.zh: 我差点就放弃了，想去住酒店，可钱包也在屋里。

sentences.en: So I had no choice but to sit on the stairs and wait.
sentences.zh: 所以我只能坐在楼梯上干等。

sentences.en: After an hour, I started eating my shopping.
sentences.zh: 等了一个钟头，我开始吃买回来的东西。

sentences.en: At one point, I nearly fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 有那么一会儿，我差点睡着了。

sentences.en: In the end, the locksmith turned up at five, while I was opening my second packet of biscuits.
sentences.zh: 最后，开锁师傅五点才到，那会儿我正在拆第二包饼干。

sentences.en: He turned the handle and pushed, and the door just opened.
sentences.zh: 他一拧门把手，一推，门就开了。

sentences.en: "That took me two seconds," he said.
sentences.zh: 「两秒钟搞定，」他说。

sentences.en: "That'll be fifty pounds."
sentences.zh: 「一共五十英镑。」

cards.note: 英式说 lift，美式说 elevator；电梯坏了常说 isn't working 或 is out of order。
slam the door 用力把门摔上；过去式双写 m：slammed。
to lift something, or to collect something that is waiting for you
作动词是「处理」：handle a problem；这里是名词，door handle 门把手。
英式说 flatmate，美式说 roommate；在英国 roommate 多指同住一个房间的人。

cards.zh: 深吸一口气（给自己壮胆、让自己镇定）
cards.note: to breathe in a lot of air, especially to calm yourself before something difficult
lock（锁）+ smith（工匠），同类的词还有 blacksmith 铁匠。
to phone someone again, or to phone someone who called you earlier
cards.tip: 人称代词放中间：call me back / call you back。「我晚点回你电话」常说 I'll call you back later。
cards.example: I'm in a meeting — can I call you back in ten minutes?

cards.note: to shut a door that locks by accident, with your keys still inside
cards.tip: yourself 跟着主语变：I locked myself out / she locked herself out。「把自己反锁在里面」是 lock yourself in。
cards.example: I locked myself out of the office last night and had to call security.

cards.text: It takes sb + 时间 + to do
cards.note: used to say how much time someone needs to do something
cards.tip: 主语用 It：It took me an hour to …。想用人做主语就换成 sb spent + 时间 + doing，不说 spent … to do。
cards.example: It takes me forty minutes to get to the office.

cards.note: climb a ladder 爬梯子；楼里的「楼梯」是 stairs，别混。
to stop trying to do something because it is too difficult
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：give up smoking，不说 give up to smoke；代词放中间：give it up。
cards.example: Don't give up on the bug yet — let's look at the logs together.

cards.note: to be forced to do something because there is nothing else you can do
cards.tip: but to 后面接动词原形：had no choice but to wait。比 have to 更强调「实在没别的办法」。
cards.example: The server was down, so we had no choice but to delay the release.

cards.note: after a long time, or after a lot of problems
cards.tip: in the end 是「经过一番周折，最后」；at the end of … 是「在……的末尾」：at the end of the meeting。
cards.example: We argued about the design for weeks, but in the end we kept the old one.

cards.note: to arrive, often late or when people are not sure you will come
cards.tip: 口语里常说人「来了、露面了」，常带点「来晚了、没想到会来」的意思；正式一点用 arrive。
cards.example: Only three people turned up for the Friday meeting.

cards.note: 英式常说 a packet of biscuits / crisps，美式多说 a package / a bag of …；biscuit 在英式里就是饼干。
